MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Taxonomy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Physiology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fish cage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
